2390-5292-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-5292-6191.description:
Gain life.
Voice of the Blessed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4060-4881-6909-6974.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{R}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4060-4881-6909-6974.description:
Cast Volatile Claws by paying {2}{R}, causing creatures you control to get +2/+0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

2577-4871-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2577-4871-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1170-2921-3536-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-3536-5131--202.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name the artifact.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2

277-774-3147.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Azorius Chancery's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-774-3147.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7156.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3703-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3703-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3188-3490-4659-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-3490-4659-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2816-4050-7026.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight legendary enchantments.
2816-4050-7026.description:
Activate Hei Bai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each legendary enchantment you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eight times by sacrificing eight Spirits, adding {3}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Hei Bai by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

372-2417-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2417-6991.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1456-5051-5078-6723.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

560-969-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

567-2034-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
567-2034-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

222-527-1879-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1879-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 5 or greater

3784-5475-6657.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Forensic Researcher ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Forensic Researcher abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-3129-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3240-4871-5686-6560.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1306-1690-2538-3836.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Urza.
1306-1690-2538-3836.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Crypt to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1306-1690-2538-3836.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

3327-3719-6523.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo is one of your commanders.
You have sacrificed a number of artifacts and/or creatures this turn equal to the number of times you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3327-3719-6523.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{B/R}{R}
Cast Deadpool by paying {2}{B}{R}, choosing to swap it and Ruthless Technomancer's text boxes as it enters the battlefield.
When Deadpool enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Ruthless Technomancer and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Deadpool by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 8.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4636-5770-6441.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating six 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Repeat.

11-2104-5131-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-2104-5131-6276.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Temporal Manipulation, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-2104-5131-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

560-4550-4616-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-4616-5686.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Moldervine Reclamation triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards and gain 2 life.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Repeat.

224-423-2309-3143-5414.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Fall of the Thran has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
224-423-2309-3143-5414.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fall of the Thran triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Fall of the Thran's second or third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land, preventing the next 2 damage that would be dealt to any target this turn.
You may optionally repeat step 3 one additional time.
If Fall of the Thran has three loyalty counters on it, activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a lore counter from Fall of the Thran, causing you to populate.
Resolve the Fall of the Thran chapter trigger from step 2, causing each player to return two land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Whenever the land(s) enter the battlefield, Evolution Sage and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger for each land that entered the battlefield under your control.
Holding priority, if the land(s) enter the battlefield untapped, you may activate them by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, if applicable, either causing you to scry 1 or to tap or untap target creature.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Repeat from step 2.
If applicable, resolve all remaining Evolution Sage triggers, causing you to proliferate that many times.
If you sacrifice and return two lands each cycle, this combo will net infinite untap of creatures you control and infinite scry 1.

2092-3493-4949.notablePrerequisites:
Patrol Signaler does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-3493-4949.description:
Activate Patrol Signaler by tapping it, adding {W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

717-779-833-1283.description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's second ability by paying {2} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3446-4934-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2556-2665-3617.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Mnemonic Wall.
2556-2665-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the token Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
